subject: Enablement sprint commander checklist — streaming, tool-calls, structured outputs
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Turner <claire.turner@novushealth.io>, DevOps Team <devops@novushealth.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Sprint Commander checklist — streaming, tool-calls, structured outputs

Hi Claire + Novus DevOps,

Attaching a compact "Sprint Commander" checklist I put together to make the enablement kickoff very actionable. Goal is to get streaming + function/tool calling + structured outputs (JSON schema contracts) into an initial pilot in 3 sprints (~6 weeks). The attachment has a simple matrix and ownership cells; key sections are: scope, gating criteria, pre-kick tasks, demo checklist, and rollback/fallback rules.

High-level asks before kickoff: 
- Confirm which dataset(s) we can use for the initial pilot (PII-scrubbed is ideal).
- Share any procurement/legal constraints that would block us from deploying a dedicated test instance.
- Provide the list of engineers who will join the technical kickoff (names + Slack handles).

Proposed kickoff windows (all PST): Tue Dec 15 10:00–11:00, Wed Dec 16 15:00–16:00, or Thu Dec 17 09:00–10:00. Please confirm one.

Quick notes on the technical approach (so everyone has the context):
- Streaming: we'll use Redwood's continuous streaming endpoint for low-latency live outputs. We'll enable prefix/KV cache where helpful.
- Function/tool calling: we recommend starting with two tool integrations — a canonical DB lookup and a short HTTP webhook — so we can validate sync vs async tool behaviors.
- Structured outputs: we'll lock a small JSON schema (see schema_proposal_v0.9.json attached) for the first sprint and run automated schema conformance checks in CI.

Attachments: sprint_commander_checklist_v1.xlsx, schema_proposal_v0.9.json, mutual_action_plan.md

Next steps for us internally: Ben will assemble a 15–20 minute demo of function/tool calling (live), Kimberly will draft the CI gating job for schema checks, Marissa will prepare the deployment runbook for the test environment.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

—
Soojin Lee
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Claire Turner <claire.turner@novushealth.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: DevOps Team <devops@novushealth.io>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 09:04:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Sprint Commander checklist — streaming, tool-calls, structured outputs

Thanks Soojin — this is helpful and very concrete. A couple quick questions from our side before we lock the kickoff: 

1) Data retention / compliance: we need to confirm retention policies for streaming logs and any cached prefixes. Can Redwood expose an audit log for the pilot and a SOC2 artifact that covers logs?

2) Tool calling detail: when you say "function/tool calling" — can the runtime call customer-hosted webhooks (we'd prefer to keep our patient lookups in-house) or does this require pushing data into Redwood-managed connectors? Any examples of request/response contract you can share?

3) JSON schema enforcement: we want the schema validation to fail the pipeline if the model emits an invalid structure. Is that supported today or will that be a manual step in CI?

We'll confirm the attendee list and prefer the Dec 16 15:00 slot.

Claire Turner
Head of Integrations, Novus Health
claire.turner@novushealth.io

On Sat, Dec 5, 2026 at 2:12 PM Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> (original message quoted)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Claire Turner <claire.turner@novushealth.io>, DevOps Team <devops@novushealth.io>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 10:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Sprint Commander checklist — action items for the tech leads

Folks — forwarding Claire's questions. She confirmed Dec 16 15:00 PST for kickoff. Please see Claire's items inline below; I've added my immediate notes and assigned quick owners. We should have short deliverables by EOD Tue 12/8 so we can include them in the kickoff packet.

Claire Q1: Data retention / compliance: can Redwood expose an audit log + SOC2 artifact?
- Action: Kimberly to pull the standard audit artifact link and retention options. Kimberly: please confirm if we can toggle retention at the deployment level and what the default is. (owner: kimberly_park)

Claire Q2: Tool calling detail: can the runtime call customer-hosted webhooks?
- Quick answer: yes — Redwood supports outbound HTTP tool calls from the runtime; we pass a sanitized call payload and accept JSON responses. We should document the recommended auth patterns (signed headers or mTLS) depending on Novus preference.
- Action: Ben to prepare a 10–15 minute demo showing a webhook call + a local DB lookup via an internal tool shim. (owner: ben_carter)

Claire Q3: JSON schema enforcement failing CI pipeline
- Quick answer: schema checks can be run in CI using Redwood's schema validator CLI; we can provide an example Jenkins/GitHub Actions job that marks the build red on conformance failures.
- Action: Marissa to draft the CI sample job and include it in the mutual_action_plan.md attachment. (owner: marissa_cole)

Additional asks for the pre-kick packet:
- A sanitized sample dataset (small) or schema examples Novus can share.
- List of engineers + Slack handles + their preferred time zone.
- Any procurement/legal pre-reqs that would prevent us from creating a short-lived dedicated test instance.

Ben/Kim/Marissa — can you reply with your short confirmations and any blockers by EOD Tue 12/8? I'll compile and send the kickoff packet Wed morning.

—
Soojin

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Sprint Commander checklist — action items for the tech leads

Confirming — I'll prep the webhook demo and the local DB shim. Proposed demo flow (10–12 mins):

1) Start streaming session with live prefix cache enabled (show single-turn latency)
2) Trigger HTTP webhook call from runtime to Novus stub (show request payload + headers)
3) Runtime receives JSON from stub and executes a structured output path (validated against schema_proposal_v0.9.json)
4) Show how fallback works when schema validation fails (fallback to text + error code)

I'll upload a short screencast and the demo code to the Drive folder before the kickoff: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleDriveLink (INF-1987). No immediate blockers from my side.

—Ben

From: Claire Turner <claire.turner@novushealth.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, DevOps Team <devops@novushealth.io>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Sprint Commander checklist — streaming, tool-calls, structured outputs

Thanks all — Dec 16 15:00 PST works for our team. We'll send the pre-kick packet by EOD Fri (sanitized sample + engineer list). A couple quick clarifications for the pre-work:

- For webhook auth we'd prefer mTLS where possible; if Redwood has an mTLS guide we can follow that for the stub.
- Our security team will want to review the audit log format. Kimberly, when you share the artifact link could you include an example log entry?

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Looking forward to the demo.

Claire Turner
Head of Integrations, Novus Health
